name: Margaritaville at Sea
headline: $0 cruise fares for two on select sailings
summary: Limited, auto-assigned interior cabins for two on Paradise and Islander. An alternative 20% fare discount is offered on eligible bookings.
eligibility: Qualifying military members and veterans verified through GOVX; check its full eligibility rules.
costs: Taxes, fees and port expenses are payable. Gratuities, onboard purchases and travel to the port can cost extra; third and fourth guests may pay retail fares.
redemption: Follow the cruise line’s GOVX verification link, then use its dedicated online offer booking flow.
restrictions: Select dates and limited cabins; first come, first served. Two guests required; solo travelers excluded. A $0 fare is not a free trip. No cabin inventory has been checked by DutyPerks.

name: Norwegian Cruise Line
headline: 10% off cruise fares; selected offers may save more
summary: Standard eligible cruise-fare savings are 10%. A limited 20% offer applies to selected sailings and guarantee staterooms.
eligibility: Qualifying US military members, veterans, spouses and surviving spouses verified through ID.me; see official service categories.
costs: Fare savings do not make taxes, fees, gratuities or optional packages free. Compare the full booking total.
redemption: Enroll through My NCL and ID.me before booking, then sign in to see eligible rates.
restrictions: One qualifying stateroom per verified member per sailing. Selected promotions may combine; exclusions apply. The official link may use a regional locale; confirm your country, currency and final terms.

name: Virgin Voyages
headline: Up to 15% off eligible voyage fares
summary: Selected voyages offer 5%, 10% or 15% savings, combinable with certain public promotions.
eligibility: Eligible US and Canadian military members, veterans and specified spouses. Virgin Voyages is adults only.
costs: Compare the final fare, package inclusions and extra charges. Savings vary by voyage and cabin.
redemption: Choose an eligible voyage and apply SERVICERATE as required by the offer terms. Bring qualifying ID and required travel documents.
restrictions: Selected cabin categories only. Other reduced rates and group programs may be excluded. Confirm the discount appears before paying.

name: MSC Cruises
headline: 5% or 10% off eligible cabin categories
summary: Military terms list 5% for Interior and Ocean View, and 10% for specified Balcony, Suite and Yacht Club categories.
eligibility: Eligible military or government guests must sail. Confirm service category, US residency and required proof with MSC.
costs: Check the full quote, including required charges and optional extras; savings do not apply to every trip expense.
redemption: Ask MSC or your booking provider for the military offer and confirm the eligible cabin and fare.
restrictions: Availability and cabin exclusions apply. Confirm whether your promotion can combine: the page includes both general and offer-specific combination conditions.

name: Carnival Cruise Line
headline: Military rates on eligible sailings
summary: Reduced military rates vary by sailing. No fixed savings percentage is promised.
eligibility: Qualifying US and Canadian military guests. Confirm veteran eligibility and accepted service documents with Carnival; a VA card alone is not accepted under the linked policy.
costs: Compare the complete price, deposit, cancellation terms and optional extras with public offers.
redemption: Request the military rate and follow Carnival’s document process. Proof is generally due within 72 hours, or 24 hours for bookings within a week of departure.
restrictions: Missing proof can remove the discount. Submit documents only through the provider’s approved process; DutyPerks does not collect them.

name: Royal Caribbean
headline: Special military rates on selected sailings
summary: Eligible sailings have military fare options; savings vary and are not a universal percentage.
eligibility: Qualifying active, retired and honorably discharged military guests. Veteran service-length requirements apply; check the full terms.
costs: Check total price and whether the selected rate has a nonrefundable deposit. Travel and extras may cost more.
redemption: Select an eligible MILITARY or MILITARY NRD offer and bring required proof to pier check-in.
restrictions: At least one eligible guest must occupy the qualifying stateroom. Failure to provide proof can cause repricing or denied boarding.

name: Princess Cruises
headline: Up to $250 onboard credit per qualifying guest
summary: The program table lists $50 for cruises up to 6 days, $100 for 7–13 days and $250 for 14 days or longer.
eligibility: Qualifying US and Canadian active, retired, disabled and veteran military personnel; service and documentation conditions apply.
costs: Onboard credit is spending money, not a fare discount or cash refund. Cruise costs and other charges remain payable.
redemption: Complete Princess verification in advance and confirm the credit on your reservation. Check the current application deadline before booking.
restrictions: Credit-use and combination rules apply. The official link may use a regional locale; confirm your booking’s terms and currency. Provider approval is required.

name: Holland America Line
headline: $100 onboard credit per eligible stateroom
summary: Verified military guests can receive one $100 credit per stateroom on eligible new bookings.
eligibility: Eligible US and Canadian active, retired and veteran military guests, following provider verification.
costs: Onboard credit is spending money, not a fare reduction. Cruise costs and other charges remain payable.
redemption: Verify through Holland America before making a new eligible booking, then confirm the credit on your reservation.
restrictions: Selected sailings; one credit per stateroom. No cash value; nonrefundable and nontransferable. Expires at cruise end; cannot pay casino charges, gratuities or other excluded items.
